Frequently Asked Questions


Is this stone really natural?

Yes. Each bracelet is made of natural Tiger Eye and ships with a certificate of authenticity.

What size will fit me?

Measure your wrist with a thread, then pick the nearest size. The bracelet is stretch-fit, so there is a little flexibility.

Who can wear Tiger Eye?

Anyone seeking confidence and protection. For a personal recommendation, consult your astrologer.

How long does delivery take?

We dispatch in 24–48 hours. Delivery usually takes 3–7 working days across India.

How do I place an order?

Tap any Order on WhatsApp button. A chat opens with your size and quantity already filled in. Send it and our team will reply with photos and confirm your order.

Is Cash on Delivery available?

Yes, on most pincodes.

What if I don't like it?

Return it within 7 days of delivery. Please see our return policy.

Does it guarantee results?

No. Tiger Eye is a devotional and traditional item. Experiences vary and it is not a medical or financial guarantee.
